judge.voice: Víte, the cue was good: "How is school today?" That is exactly what I want to ask Sam. But then I pressed the phrase help again and again and got "The weather is cold today", which has nothing to do with school. Pause & coach was grey. I felt rushed and a bit foolish. In the end I wrote my own words, "School good?", and Sam answered kindly. The partner spoke slowly and simply, and I liked that. The correction "Every day tomatoes" showed my real words, which I trust. But "subject and verb" is jargon, and I do not want it. I would try again on Saturday if the help were quicker and gave me one good phrase for Sunday. Now it is half useful. I would tell my friends at the library to wait a little.
